description: Source code for the Address4 class that models an IPv4 address, including parsing, validation, conversions, and subnet calculations.

classes.name: Address4
classes.description: Represents an IPv4 address with methods for validation, parsing, conversions, and subnet calculations.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes an Address4 instance, parsing address string and handling subnet mask.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given IPv4 address string is valid.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string into its constituent groups.

methods.name: correctForm
methods.description: Returns the IPv4 address in its correct dot-decimal string form.

methods.name: fromHex
methods.description: Static method converting a hex string to an Address4 instance.

methods.name: fromInteger
methods.description: Static method converting an integer to an Address4 instance.

methods.name: fromArpa
methods.description: Static method creating an Address4 instance from an in-addr.arpa string.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts the IPv4 address to a hex string.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the address to an array of four integers.

methods.name: toGroup6
methods.description: Converts the IPv4 address to a group suitable for IPv6 embedding.

methods.name: bigInt
methods.description: Returns the address as a BigInt.

methods.name: _startAddress
methods.description: Helper function calculating the start address of the subnet.

methods.name: startAddress
methods.description: Returns the first address in the subnet range.

methods.name: startAddressExclusive
methods.description: Returns the first host address in the subnet range.

methods.name: _endAddress
methods.description: Helper function calculating the end address of the subnet.

methods.name: endAddress
methods.description: Returns the last address in the subnet range.

methods.name: endAddressExclusive
methods.description: Returns the last host address in the subnet range.

methods.name: fromBigInt
methods.description: Static method converting a BigInt to an Address4 instance.

methods.name: fromByteArray
methods.description: Constructs an Address4 instance from a byte array.

methods.name: fromUnsignedByteArray
methods.description: Constructs an Address4 instance from an array of unsigned bytes.

methods.name: mask
methods.description: Returns the bits of the address up to the mask length.

methods.name: getBitsBase2
methods.description: Returns a binary substring of the address bits.

methods.name: reverseForm
methods.description: Returns the reverse DNS form of the address.

methods.name: isInSubnet
methods.description: Checks if the address is within a specified subnet.

methods.name: isMulticast
methods.description: Checks if the address is a multicast address.

methods.name: binaryZeroPad
methods.description: Returns the address as a zero-padded binary string.

methods.name: groupForV6
methods.description: Creates IPv6-compatible group string from IPv4 address.
